# Kenney CC0 pieces (Arcade Phase 1)

Unmodified models from Kenney (www.kenney.nl), CC0 1.0 Universal. Each folder keeps the pack's own `License.txt`.
Downloaded Sun Nov 15, 2026 from the asset pages below. Nothing bought; no paid tiers.

| Folder | Pack | Pieces used | Page |
|---|---|---|---|
| `city/` | City Kit (Industrial) 2.0 | `detail-tank`, `chimney-small`, `shipping-container-a`, `Textures/colormap.png` | https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-industrial |
| `nature/` | Nature Kit 2.1 | `plant_bushLarge`, `plant_bushDetailed`, `grass_leafsLarge` | https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit |

All pieces are re-skinned at runtime by `shaders/toon_world.gdshader` (gradient-mapped into the HQ palette).
Voluntary credit: "Includes CC0 assets by Kenney (kenney.nl) and Poly Haven (polyhaven.com)."
